sections.description:
FIXED AMOUNT OF CENTRAL EXCISE DUTY RULES, 1999
FIXED AMOUNT OF CENTRAL EXCISE DUTY RULES, 1999
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part 11, 24th March, 1999]
S.R.O. 179(1)/99, dated 22‑3‑1999.‑‑In
exercise of the power conferred by subsections (8) and (9) of section 3 of the
Central Excises Act, 1944 (I of 1944), read with section 37, thereof, the
Central Board of Revenue, with the prior approval of the Federal Government, is
pleased to make the following rules for the levy and collection of central
excise duty in lieu of central excise duty leviable under subsection (1) of the
said section, namely:‑‑
1. Short title, application and commencement.‑‑(1) These
rules my be called the Fixed Amount of Central Excise Duty Rules, 1999.
(2) They shall apply to the
manufacturers of goods specified in the Schedule to these rules. '
(3) They shall come into force
at once and, unless repealed earlier, shall remain in force during the
financial year 1998‑99.
2. Definitions.‑‑In these rules, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context,‑--
(a) "Act" means the
Central Excises Act, 1944 (1 of 1944);
(b) "Assistant
Collector" means the Assistant Collector of Central Excise within whose
jurisdiction the manufacturer's business is situated and in case where there is
no Assistant Collector it means the Deputy Collector of Central Excise in whose
jurisdiction the manufacturer's business is situated;
(c) "Association"
means the respective association of manufacturers duly recognized by the
Federal Government;
(d) "Anjuman" means
the All Pakistan Anjuman‑e‑Tajran
(e) "Board" means the
Central Board of Revenue;
(f) "Collector" means
the Collector of Central Excise within whose jurisdiction the manufacturer's
business is situated;
(g) "Federation"
means the Federation of associations paying fixed sales 'tax;
(h) "Joint Survey
Committee" means the Joint Survey Committee constituted under sub‑rule
(2) of rule 4;
(i) "Manufacturer"
means the manufacturer of goods specified in the Schedule;
(j) "Schedule" means
the Schedule to these rules; and
(k) "Superintendent"
means the Superintendent of Central Excise within whose jurisdiction the
manufacturer's business is situated.
(2) All other words and
expressions used, but not defined in these rules, shall have the meaning
assigned to them in the Act.
3. Guiding principles for fixation of duty.‑(1) The fixed amount
of duty payable by an establishment or undertaking during the financial year
1998‑99 shall be worked out by the Collector Excise having the
jurisdiction on the basis of the following guiding principles, namely:‑‑
(i) only such manufacturers
shall be liable to pay the fixed amount of duty under these rules who have been
paying fixed amount of duty during the financial years 1995‑96, 1996‑97
and 1997‑98 and opt to pay fixed amount of excise duty.
(ii) the financial year 1997‑98
shall be taken as the base year for working out the fixed amount of duty for
the financial year 1998‑99;
(iii) fixed amount of duty for
the financial year 1998‑99 shall be forty per cent. over and above the
amount of duty fixed or paid during the financial year, 1997‑98;
(iv) any unit which had paid
more duty than calculated on the basis of forty, per cent. increase during any
month of the financial year, 1998‑99, shall pay monthly instalment equal
to the maximum amount of duty paid during any month;
(v) fixed amount of duty worked
out in terms of clause (iii) shall apply to the installed machinery declared by
the units to the Central Excise Department for the financial year 1997‑98;
(vi) liability for payment of
fixed amount of duty shall be re‑assessed by the Collector if any of the
unit alters installs or adds any new or used machinery or equipment during the
current financial year or after the last survey conducted;
(vii) central excise duty
payable‑from the 1st July, 1998, to the 28th February, 1999, calculated
under the clause (iii), shall be payable not later than the 25th March, 1999,
